subject: The lathe drawn side-on as an engineering elevation on the left, with the groove wall as it plays back traced on the right.
controls: cut: shape - the played trace's amplitude grows and its peaks flatten into plateaus as the cutter saturates (nodes 3-4).
groove: position - the cutter head (node 0) travels along the cantilevered rail from the rim toward the spindle, 56 px, and the radius dimension under the plinth lengthens with it.
wear: count - crackle ticks appear above the trace, 0 to 16, a click per tick; none at 0.
rumble: shape - the trace's grey centre line (nodes 1-2) bends into a slow 1.2-cycle wave, 0 to +-12 px; flat at 0.
reference: opxy/reference/README.md (MNMD FM STAT / VO-6 split layout, linked)
risks: Two places to look; the left elevation only carries groove, so knobs 1, 3 and 4 all act on the right half and P7's column split doesn't hold. The elevation's plinth, rail and column are boxes and could tip into a 'panel' look. Two languages in one frame (elevation, trace) must share weights. The trace is 200 px, so cut needs two mutable paths and rumble two more: all four paths spent. No note input on an effect, so the trace never scrolls; it is a picture of one turn, not a scope.
